note: The v1 record shape, minted from the build that predates shard schema v2 (WrongWay origin/main @ ca6e749) by driving SelfPlayBatch against the deterministic mock evaluator. It is the left half of the golden in rust/normal-duel-core/tests/record_schema_v2.rs: the v2 build replays the same options and its records must agree with these digests over the first `prefixFloats` floats of every record, and over the whole meta buffer. A schema change that perturbs the GAME rather than merely widening the record breaks both.
config: 9x9 standard, initialStock 10/10, repetitionThreshold 3, plyCap 200, firstPlayer A
digestAlgorithm: FNV-1a 64, over the little-endian bytes of the values in order
outcomesNote: All four games are DRAWS at 48/35/29/56 plies against a cap of 60, so every one of them ended in threefold repetition rather than truncation. That is deliberate: a corpus whose games repeat positions is the one where a carried repetition window has something to carry, and these records include windows with counts above 1.
